question:

(A) [0.7249, 0.1755, 0.8849, 0.3355]
(B) [0.1867, 0.2602, 0.3467, 0.4202]
(C) [0.7191, 0.4735, 0.8791, 0.6335]
(D) No building change in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
